name: Alfred Akagi
original_name: アルフレッド 赤城
source:
The leader of an American-Japanese mafia branch in Tokyo. Going after Club Primavera, after money and its passionate Madam Rose, he is the first threat Primavera has to fight in the story

[source: TV Tropes]
